name: @caisson/service-license
description: Merchant-of-Record billing webhook + idempotent credit grants + account-entitlement store/resolver (P6, ADR-0089/0017/0071). A gated invoice.paid grants cycle credits AND the plan's entitlements; resolveAccountEntitlements expands stored purchased ids to member slugs against the registry index. Ed25519 license issuer lands in a follow-on Bucket-B slice.
